Use beUI Pro from your coding agent

name: beUI Pro
summary: Paid library of motion-rich React components, animated blocks and full Next.js landing-page templates.
description: Catalog of animated React components, blocks and complete Next.js landing-page templates, installed through a private shadcn-compatible registry with a license token or downloaded as source files kept in your codebase. Covers page sections (navbar, hero, features, pricing, footer), app surfaces (dashboards, kanban, data tables, calendar, auth, file manager) and AI-agent interfaces (model picker, agent chat input, thinking loaders). Includes an agent skill, an MCP server and a WebGL background studio; source targets React 19, Next.js, Tailwind CSS v4 and Motion.
contains: 292 premium components, 205 animated blocks, 41 page blocks and 11 full templates (homepage counters)
install via private shadcn-compatible registry with a license token, or download the source
blocks: hero, features, pricing, testimonials, CTA, footer, logo cloud, FAQ, stats, navbar, team
app surfaces: dashboards, kanban, data tables, calendar, sidebar, auth, file manager, status pages
AI-agent parts: model picker, agent chat input, AI thinking loaders, artifacts, agent builder
agent skill and MCP server (mcp.beui.dev) with list, search, inspect and install tools
full templates: Weave, Hunch, Folio, Pair, Personal Website
pricing: $109/year or $149 lifetime; React 19, Next.js, Tailwind CSS v4, Motion
